request.subject: UNIT:GUARD

layers.text: Change two things only. The shield: make it taller and wider, a big tower shield whose flat bottom edge rests on the ground and whose top reaches his chin, hiding his legs completely; same crimson with the gold cross and steel border. His shoulders: one big round steel pauldron on each. Do not redraw anything else: keep the face, kettle helmet with its gold band, upright spear, pose, proportions, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
